retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome composition featuring a seated central figure in satin and fur, framed by theatrical curtains and a secondary standing figure.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white fashion

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic black-and-white scene depicting a glamorous woman in a satin gown and fur stole seated in an ornate armchair, attended by a man in a tuxedo, framed by metallic-sheen curtains and bold serif typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Central seated figure as the primary focal point
Secondary standing figure providing vertical balance on the left
Theatrical curtains acting as a vignette frame
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows and bright highlights on satin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The female subject is centered and mid-ground, occupying the lower two-thirds of the vertical axis.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright highlight on the satin gown at the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold typography at the top, down the standing figure on the left, to the seated central figure, and finally to the hand mirror on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black shadows in the background and the man's tuxedo provide negative space that carves out the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and absolute black for shadows
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for highlights on skin and fabric
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for metallic and satin textures
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range with limited mid-tones to mimic silver-gelatin prints.

letterConstructionRules: Wide character width for the primary title
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged initial and terminal letters in the main title to span the width of the frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large, high-contrast display serif paired with a smaller, more legible book serif.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and dramatic weight of the display text.
Provides the elegant, fashion-forward serif look typical of this era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a woman in a 1940s satin gown and fur stole sitting in a rococo armchair. A man in a tuxedo stands to the left, partially in shadow. Frame the scene with blurred vertical metallic curtains on the left and right edges. Use theatrical lighting to create sharp highlights on the satin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold serif title in white at the top edge, spanning the width. Add a smaller subtitle in a matching serif font, right-aligned just below the main title.

verificationChecks: Does the lighting create high-contrast specular highlights on the dress?
Is the typography a high-contrast serif?
Are the vertical curtain elements present on the edges?

adjustableVariables: Degree of shadow depth on the standing figure

avoid: Modern digital sharpness without film-like texture

postGenerationChecks: Verify serif typography is sharp and legible
Ensure the central figure is the brightest part of the image
Confirm the framing curtains do not obscure the main subject
recipe.reuseFormula: Noir Glamour = (High-Contrast Monochrome + Satin/Fur Textures) * (Theatrical Framing + Bold Didone Typography)
